name: fairlens-demo-video
description: The FairLens demo video, built with Remotion from the live site and its real output on the UCI Adult census data.

scripts.render: remotion render FairLensDemo out/fairlens-demo-1x.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/fairlens-demo-1x.mp4 -filter:v setpts=PTS/1.25 -r 30 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 20 -movflags +faststart out/fairlens-demo.mp4
